correctness.rationale: The dephased unit-modulus determinant proves rank<3 iff two rows or columns are proportional, including all boundary cases where factors vanish. Exact divisibility of Fourier entry products turns these conditions into t+s≥a or r+u≥a, while all two-by-two minors vanish precisely for r+s≥a. An ultrametric trichotomy yields all possible profiles, each counted by a direct and nonoverlapping combinatorial construction. Exhaustive exact cyclotomic determinant and rank checks for N=4,8,9,16 and exact random samples for N=25,27,32,49,125 independently match formulas; these finite checks are not used as proof of the infinite theorem.

value.rationale: This is a complete classification and exact census of a natural Fourier-sampling erasure invariant for all cyclic prime powers. It distinguishes lost two- and three-dimensional reconstruction ranks instead of only full-spark status, detects the dyadic thresholds 8 and 16, and gives profile multiplicities that make any exponent accessible by finite arithmetic O(a^4) rather than enumeration of binomially many minors. It extends beyond the known odd-prime-square case to infinitely many larger exponents and a structurally different characteristic-two branch; the result is not a routine equality renaming or an arbitrary small numeric slice.
